name: Goddess of Victory: Nikke - No caller ID
storyline:
One day, the Ark received a message with no Caller ID. The source of the signal came from the ground.
However, in the official information of the Central Government, there were 0 survivors on the ground.
What exactly is happening?
summary: No Caller ID follows the story of Counters squad who are tasked in finding the source of a mysterious transmission sourced from the surface, believed to be human survivors.
